g.text: Running Agents on a Monorepo With Worktrees
Single shared Git object store powers isolated agent checkouts without clone bloat or index.lock contention
Shared once across all agents • 0 MB redundant clone data
All agent paths are pinned inside .orca-worktrees/
Zero chance of agent checkouts polluting parent file trees
while Agent B and C run concurrently
HMR & dev servers bind separate ports
Each worktree has its own git index
Diff agent work against main in real time
